title: How many pallets of TLD 30s a national Central Medical Stores should order on the children's line of its January to June 2027 order, when children are weighed into the 30 kg band at visits that just became less frequent
subdomain: utilization, access and demand forecasting (a national ARV quantification: the children's line of the C7 TLD order, the paediatric regimen transitions forecast child by child from the register's scheduled weighings)
prompt_shape: the children's line of one cycle's TLD order in whole pallets with the children it carries, the adults' line with its consumption, maximum stock and the stock and shipments it nets, each region's CMS deliveries and reported dispensing over the last two closed cycles, and a chart of those deliveries and that dispensing by region for each cycle, every bar labelled
